assertions: Original local Excel A1 address/range parsing and formatting feed actual ScAddress/ScRange owners without a second spreadsheet model.
Native partial mutation, absolute flags, full-axis ranges and ParseAny fallback remain source-shaped.
record.capability: Local Excel A1 and OOXML coordinate parsing and serialization
gaps: J0Z0KF admits original local Excel A1/OOXML scanning and formatting through actual ScAddress/ScRange and ScDocument limits. Preserve signed64 row conversion, optional signs, native partial coordinate/absolute-flag mutations, whole-axis ranges, unsorted endpoints, ParseAny fallback and native full-address-notation control. Qualifying sheet/external headers, injected error-token services and R1C1 remain explicitly unsupported; no replacement resolver or global workbook service is supplied. Existing OOO/ODF parsing and UI callers remain on their prior route. Source-backed tests use actual native-model owners; no full native differential, full parser parity or XLSX/UI readiness follows. Coverage retains original singleton branches and the unchanged100 gate; two local-domain branches remain uncovered rather than being deleted or excluded.
